items.reason_zh: 已认证的 X 客户端可利用堆缓冲区溢出漏洞使 X 服务器上下文崩溃或执行代码，直接影响桌面环境的稳定性和安全性。

items.reason_en: Windows-specific path validation bypass in Git allows malicious repositories to write files outside the worktree, enabling remote code execution on developer machines.
items.reason_zh: Git 中针对 Windows 的路径验证绕过漏洞允许恶意仓库在工作树外部写入文件，从而在开发人员机器上实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Heap buffer overflow in X.org/XWayland allows authenticated clients to trigger crashes or code execution in the display server context.
items.reason_zh: X.org/XWayland 中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞允许已认证客户端在显示服务器上下文中触发崩溃或代码执行。

items.reason_en: OS command injection in Topluyo Desktop Linux enables URL-controlled attackers to execute arbitrary system commands on target machines.
items.reason_zh: Topluyo Desktop Linux 中的操作系统命令注入漏洞允许受 URL 控制的攻击者在目标机器上执行任意系统命令。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated Java RMI service in NoviGest Desktop App permits remote method invocation, credential theft, and arbitrary SQL queries.
items.reason_zh: NoviGest Desktop App 中未认证的 Java RMI 服务允许远程方法调用、凭据窃取和任意 SQL 查询。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Teams for Android allows authorized attackers to perform network-based spoofing attacks on mobile devices.
items.reason_zh: Android 版 Microsoft Teams 中的跨站脚本漏洞允许已认证的攻击者在移动设备上实施基于网络的欺骗攻击。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.1 Improper access control in Microsoft 365 Copilot for iOS allows unauthorized privilege escalation over the network.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.1 的 iOS 版 Microsoft 365 Copilot 访问控制不当漏洞允许通过网络进行未授权的权限提升。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.5 Time-of-check time-of-use race condition in Edge for Android enables remote code execution via malicious web content.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 7.5 的 Android 版 Edge 检查时使用竞争条件漏洞允许通过恶意 Web 内容实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.4 External file path control in Edge for Android allows unauthorized information disclosure over the network.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 7.4 的 Android 版 Edge 外部文件路径控制漏洞允许通过网络进行未授权的信息泄露。

items.reason_en: Path traversal vulnerability in Microsoft Teams for Android bypasses app sandboxing, potentially exposing sensitive user files or enabling local code execution on mobile devices.
items.reason_zh: Android 版 Microsoft Teams 中的路径遍历漏洞绕过了应用沙箱机制，可能暴露敏感用户文件或允许在移动设备上执行本地代码。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in Edge for Android allows local information disclosure, potentially exposing sensitive user data and application files.
items.reason_zh: Android 版 Edge 中的路径遍历漏洞可导致本地信息泄露，可能暴露敏感用户数据和应用程序文件。

items.reason_en: Improper restriction of rendered UI layers in the Bing App for iOS enables network-based UI spoofing attacks to trick users.
items.reason_zh: iOS版Bing应用中渲染的UI层限制不当，可导致基于网络的UI欺骗攻击以诱骗用户。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated access to the Android Debug Bridge daemon provides immediate system footholds and facilitates rapid privilege escalation to root on affected devices.
items.reason_zh: 对Android Debug Bridge守护进程的无需身份验证访问可立即提供系统立足点，并促使在受影响设备上快速提权至root。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in a native binder service allows unprivileged applications to execute arbitrary OS commands as root, completely bypassing Android sandbox restrictions.
items.reason_zh: 原生binder服务中缺少授权检查，允许非特权应用以root身份执行任意操作系统命令，从而完全绕过Android沙箱限制。

items.reason_en: Logcat-based command injection in a privileged helper daemon enables local processes to achieve full root compromise by manipulating system logs.
items.reason_zh: 特权辅助守护进程中基于Logcat的命令注入使本地进程能够通过操纵系统日志获取完整的root权限。

items.reason_en: Incorrect permission assignment in the Windows Mobile Broadband driver allows local privilege escalation on cellular-connected mobile devices.
items.reason_zh: Windows移动宽带驱动程序中的权限分配错误可在蜂窝网络连接的设备上导致本地提权。

items.reason_en: Flawed signature verification in unconfirmed mempool transactions allows malicious servers to replace broadcasts, potentially stealing user cryptocurrency funds.
items.reason_zh: 未确认的mempool交易中签名验证存在缺陷，允许恶意服务器替换广播，可能导致用户加密货币资金被盗。

items.reason_en: Critical remote backdoor in D-Link home routers allows unauthenticated attackers to gain full device control via crafted CGI arguments.
items.reason_zh: D-Link家用路由器中存在关键远程后门，未经身份验证的攻击者可利用构造的CGI参数获取设备的完全控制权。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in Signal K Server enables unauthenticated log downloads that reveal JWT secrets for persistent administrative takeover.
items.reason_zh: Signal K Server中缺少身份验证机制，允许未经身份验证的用户下载日志并泄露JWT密钥，从而实现持久的管理接管。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Totolink router firmware allows authenticated remote code execution, severely compromising home and small-office network gateways.
items.reason_zh: Totolink路由器固件中存在基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许经身份验证的攻击者执行远程代码，严重危及家庭及小型办公网络网关的安全。

items.reason_en: Hostname processing overflow in the same router model enables arbitrary command execution, posing persistent risks to IoT device confidentiality and network perimeter security.
items.reason_zh: 该路由器型号的主机名处理溢出漏洞可导致任意命令执行，对物联网设备机密性及网络边界安全构成长期威胁。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass via IP spoofing in the CGM CLININET rsyncd service allows unauthorized file editing on connected medical devices.
items.reason_zh: CGM CLININET rsyncd服务中存在通过IP欺骗绕过身份验证的漏洞，允许对已连接的医疗设备进行未经授权的文件编辑。

items.reason_en: A hardcoded backdoor in the root-privileged assistant daemon allows physically present attackers to execute arbitrary OS commands via USB, undermining device integrity.
items.reason_zh: 具有root权限的助手守护进程中存在硬编码后门，允许物理接触攻击者通过USB执行任意操作系统命令，破坏设备完整性。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in the update service permits unprivileged apps to trigger destructive operations like factory resets and system shutdowns on drone hardware.
items.reason_zh: 更新服务中缺少授权检查，允许非特权应用对无人机硬件触发恢复出厂设置和系统关机等破坏性操作。

items.reason_en: Remote command injection in TOTOLINK router firmware allows unauthenticated attackers to gain full device control via manipulated module upload arguments.
items.reason_zh: TOTOLINK路由器固件中存在远程命令注入漏洞，未经身份验证的攻击者可利用篡改的模块上传参数获取设备的完全控制权。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in TOTOLINK wireless configuration CGI enables remote code execution, exposing home and small business networks to complete compromise.
items.reason_zh: TOTOLINK无线配置CGI中存在基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可导致远程代码执行，使家庭及中小企业网络面临被完全攻陷的风险。

items.reason_en: Remote buffer overflow in Tenda router firmware allows unauthenticated attackers to take full control of the network device.
items.reason_zh: Tenda路由器固件中存在远程缓冲区溢出漏洞，未经身份验证的攻击者可借此获取网络设备的完全控制权。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Alpine Android Auto service enables remote code execution on vehicle infotainment systems without authentication.
items.reason_zh: Alpine Android Auto服务中存在基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可在无需身份验证的情况下于车载信息娱乐系统中执行远程代码。

items.reason_en: Critical stack-based buffer overflow in router firmware web management interface allows unauthenticated remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: 路由器固件Web管理界面中存在关键的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，允许未经身份验证的攻击者执行远程代码。

items.reason_en: Configuration flaw forces empty passwords in firmware, leaving home networking devices completely unprotected against unauthorized access.
items.reason_zh: 固件中的配置缺陷强制使用空密码，导致家庭网络设备在防范未授权访问方面完全缺乏保护。

items.reason_en: Exposed dangerous functions in automotive infotainment frameworks allow network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code without authentication.
items.reason_zh: 车载信息娱乐框架中暴露的危险函数允许网络邻近攻击者在无需身份验证的情况下执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: ESPHome Dashboard binds to all network interfaces while bypassing authentication, exposing home automation controls to local networks.
items.reason_zh: ESPHome Dashboard绑定至所有网络接口且未实施身份验证，导致家庭自动化控制面板暴露于局域网中。

items.reason_en: Missing access controls in Xibo digital signage allow authenticated users to modify or delete any layout, disrupting content delivery workflows.
items.reason_zh: Xibo数字标牌中缺少访问控制机制，允许已认证用户修改或删除任意布局，从而干扰内容分发工作流。

items.reason_en: Offline-vulnerable database backups in AXIS Camera Station require immediate credential rotation to prevent offline cracking attacks.
items.reason_zh: AXIS Camera Station中存在离线漏洞的数据库备份要求立即轮换凭据，以防止离线破解攻击。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization checks allow any authenticated user to start, stop, or query IoT gateway tunnels, potentially disrupting connected industrial or smart devices.
items.reason_zh: 缺少授权检查使得任何已认证用户均可启动、停止或查询IoT网关隧道，可能中断已连接的工业或智能设备运行。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authorization in Azure Arc allows unauthenticated attackers to elevate privileges across hybrid cloud management infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Azure Arc中的授权逻辑错误允许未经身份验证的攻击者在混合云管理基础设施中提升权限。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Azure SQL Database enables unauthenticated privilege escalation and internal network reconnaissance.
items.reason_zh: Azure SQL Database中存在服务端请求伪造漏洞，可实现无需身份验证的提权及内部网络侦察。

items.reason_en: Argument injection in Azure Managed Instance for Apache Cassandra allows unauthenticated remote code execution in managed database clusters.
items.reason_zh: Azure Managed Instance for Apache Cassandra中存在参数注入漏洞，允许在托管数据库集群中实现无需身份验证的远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: A perfect CVSS score indicates trivial exploitation, allowing attackers to hijack DNS configurations and compromise cloud identity and resolution services.
items.reason_zh: 满分CVSS评分表明该漏洞极易利用，攻击者可借此劫持DNS配置并破坏云身份与解析服务。

items.reason_en: This access control flaw breaks tenant isolation in Azure PaaS environments, potentially granting attackers full control over hosted applications and underlying resources.
items.reason_zh: 此访问控制缺陷破坏了Azure PaaS环境中的租户隔离机制，可能使攻击者获得对托管应用及底层资源的完全控制权。

items.reason_en: Authentication failures in Azure Key Vault expose cryptographic secrets and certificates, severely impacting downstream application security and compliance.
items.reason_zh: Azure Key Vault中的身份验证缺陷会泄露加密密钥与证书，严重影响下游应用的安全性及合规性。

items.reason_en: AI-integrated productivity suites are increasingly targeted; this deserialization flaw enables remote code execution within the cloud collaboration environment.
items.reason_zh: 集成AI的生产力套件正成为日益频繁的攻击目标；此反序列化漏洞可在云协作环境中实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: CVSS 10 Improper access control in Azure Cosmos DB allows unauthenticated remote code execution, critically threatening cloud data integrity.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 10 Azure Cosmos DB 访问控制不当，允许未经身份验证的远程代码执行，严重威胁云数据完整性。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8 Improper access control in Azure API Management allows compromised accounts to execute code over the network.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8 Azure API Management 访问控制不当，允许被攻陷的账户通过网络执行代码。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 Command injection in Microsoft Copilot enables unauthenticated attackers to exfiltrate sensitive data over the network.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.8 Microsoft Copilot 命令注入漏洞使未授权攻击者能够通过网络窃取敏感数据。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.1 Missing authentication in Azure CycleCloud allows privilege escalation within cloud orchestration and deployment environments.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.1 Azure CycleCloud 缺少身份验证机制，可在云编排与部署环境中导致权限提升。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited in the wild per CISA KEV, this code injection flaw in SharePoint allows network-based remote code execution, severely impacting cloud collaboration platforms.
items.reason_zh: 根据CISA KEV记录，该SharePoint代码注入漏洞已在野外被积极利用，支持基于网络的远程代码执行，严重影响云协作平台。

items.reason_en: Critical deserialization vulnerability in Dynamics NAV enables remote code execution over the network, threatening enterprise resource planning and business continuity.
items.reason_zh: Dynamics NAV 存在关键反序列化漏洞，可支持网络远程代码执行，威胁企业资源规划及业务连续性。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in on-premises Dynamics 365 allows network-based code execution, compromising enterprise workflow and data management services.
items.reason_zh: 本地部署版 Dynamics 365 对不可信数据进行反序列化，可导致基于网络的代码执行，破坏企业工作流与数据管理服务。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Exchange Server permits authenticated attackers to execute code over the network, directly disrupting organizational email infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Server 堆缓冲区溢出漏洞允许已认证攻击者通过网络执行代码，直接扰乱组织邮件基础设施。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Fabric Data Warehouse exposes cloud analytics pipelines to remote code execution, risking sensitive data processing environments.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Fabric Data Warehouse 栈缓冲区溢出漏洞使云分析管道面临远程代码执行风险，危及敏感数据处理环境。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Entra ID enables unauthenticated remote code execution, threatening global identity federation and tenant access controls.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Entra ID 对不可信数据进行反序列化，可实现未经身份验证的远程代码执行，威胁全球身份联合与租户访问控制。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Exchange Online allows attackers to pivot internally and escalate privileges within Microsoft 365 email infrastructure, risking mass data exfiltration.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Online 服务器端请求伪造漏洞允许攻击者在内部横向移动并在 Microsoft 365 邮件基础设施中提升权限，面临大规模数据泄露风险。

items.reason_en: Untrusted data deserialization in Azure Service Bus permits remote code execution, jeopardizing message queue integrity and downstream cloud workload security.
items.reason_zh: Azure Service Bus 不可信数据反序列化漏洞允许远程代码执行，危及消息队列完整性及下游云工作负载安全。

items.reason_en: Modification of assumed-immutable data in Azure Active Directory allows privilege escalation and directory policy tampering, fundamentally breaking enterprise identity governance.
items.reason_zh: Azure Active Directory 中被视为不可变的数据遭篡改，可导致权限提升和目录策略被修改，从根本上破坏企业身份治理。

items.reason_en: Tenant isolation flaw in Red Hat AI gateway allows authenticated attackers to access other tenants' credentials and models, breaching multi-tenancy security.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat AI gateway 的多租户隔离缺陷允许已认证攻击者访问其他租户的凭据和模型，违反多租户安全边界。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in Azure CycleCloud allows network-based privilege escalation, risking direct compromise of cloud orchestration infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Azure CycleCloud 缺少身份验证机制，可导致基于网络的权限提升，危及云编排基础设施的直接沦陷。

items.reason_en: Improper certificate validation in Azure Connected Machine Agent enables adjacent network privilege escalation, undermining cloud endpoint trust.
items.reason_zh: Azure Connected Machine Agent 证书验证不当，可实现相邻网络权限提升，破坏云终端信任体系。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in the Microsoft Entra Provisioning Service enables attackers to pivot internally and escalate privileges across cloud identities.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Entra Provisioning Service 服务器端请求伪造漏洞使攻击者能够进行内部横向移动，并在跨云身份中提升权限。

items.reason_en: SSRF vulnerability in Azure OpenAI allows authenticated users to probe internal networks and escalate privileges within the cloud environment.
items.reason_zh: Azure OpenAI 服务器端请求伪造漏洞允许已认证用户探测内部网络并在云环境中提升权限。

items.reason_en: Improper authorization in Azure Red Hat OpenShift allows authenticated users to bypass controls and escalate privileges over the network.
items.reason_zh: Azure Red Hat OpenShift 授权不当，允许已认证用户绕过控制措施并实现网络权限提升。

items.reason_en: SSRF in Azure AI Search facilitates unauthorized internal resource access and privilege escalation for authenticated attackers targeting AI workloads.
items.reason_zh: Azure AI Search 服务器端请求伪造漏洞为针对AI工作负载的已认证攻击者提供了未经授权的内部资源访问及权限提升途径。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in Azure App Service allows unauthenticated remote code execution, directly threatening cloud-hosted applications and tenant data isolation.
items.reason_zh: Azure App Service 缺少身份验证机制，允许未经身份验证的远程代码执行，直接威胁云托管应用及租户数据隔离。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in Microsoft Dataverse enables unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code across the cloud data platform.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Dataverse 对不可信数据进行反序列化，使未授权攻击者能够在整个云数据平台上执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Authorization bypass through user-controlled keys in Microsoft Bookings grants unauthorized privilege escalation, compromising multi-tenant scheduling services.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Bookings 通过用户可控密钥绕过授权，导致未授权的权限提升，破坏多租户调度服务。

items.reason_en: Improper certificate validation in Microsoft Partner Center allows network-based privilege escalation, undermining identity and partner management workflows.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Partner Center 证书验证不当，可导致基于网络的权限提升，破坏身份与合作伙伴管理流程。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.3 OS command injection in Azure CycleCloud enables local code execution on managed compute nodes. This directly threatens cloud cluster orchestration and tenant isolation.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 7.3 Azure CycleCloud 操作系统命令注入漏洞可在受管计算节点上实现本地代码执行，直接威胁云集群编排与租户隔离。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 path traversal vulnerability in Dynamics Business Central allows network-based privilege escalation. Attackers can bypass directory restrictions to access sensitive ERP data.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 8.8 Dynamics Business Central 路径遍历漏洞支持基于网络的权限提升。攻击者可绕过目录限制以访问敏感的ERP数据。

items.reason_en: Improper cryptographic signature verification in Active Directory Federation Services enables network spoofing attacks against enterprise identity providers and SSO gateways.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory Federation Services 密码学签名验证不当，可对企业的身份提供商和单点登录网关实施网络欺骗攻击。

items.reason_en: Incorrect authorization in Active Directory Domain Services allows unauthenticated network-based code execution, threatening central directory and identity infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory Domain Services 授权逻辑错误，允许未经身份验证的基于网络的代码执行，威胁核心目录与身份基础设施。

items.reason_en: Improper communication channel restriction in Azure Key Vault allows network-based privilege escalation. This directly undermines cloud identity management and secrets protection.
items.reason_zh: Azure Key Vault 通信通道限制不当，可导致基于网络的权限提升，直接破坏云身份管理与机密保护机制。

items.reason_en: Weak authentication in Azure Key Vault enables security feature bypass over the network. Attackers could leverage this to access sensitive cryptographic keys and tenant credentials.
items.reason_zh: Azure Key Vault中的弱身份验证可导致通过网络绕过安全功能。攻击者可利用此漏洞访问敏感的加密密钥和租户凭据。

items.reason_en: Dockhand Docker management application exposes an unauthenticated WebSocket terminal endpoint, allowing remote attackers to execute commands directly inside containers.
items.reason_zh: Dockhand Docker管理应用暴露了未经验证的WebSocket终端端点，允许远程攻击者直接在容器内执行命令。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in Microsoft Azure Attestation service allows information disclosure over a network, potentially undermining device health verification workflows.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Azure Attestation服务中的越界读取漏洞可导致网络信息泄露，可能破坏设备健康验证工作流。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows unauthenticated network attackers to execute code, targeting cloud-hosted collaboration platforms and risking tenant-wide data breaches.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未经身份验证的网络攻击者执行代码，针对云托管协作平台，并可能导致租户范围的数据泄露。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables authorized attackers to execute code over the network, threatening cloud document management and workflow automation services.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞使授权攻击者能够通过网络执行代码，威胁云文档管理和工作流自动化服务。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows authorized attackers to elevate privileges, potentially accessing internal metadata services and compromising cloud storage configurations.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint中的服务器端请求伪造漏洞允许授权攻击者提升权限，可能访问内部元数据服务并破坏云存储配置。

items.reason_en: Path traversal flaw in SharePoint enables attackers to bypass security restrictions and deploy malicious payloads directly onto cloud-hosted file servers.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint中的路径遍历缺陷使攻击者能够绕过安全限制，并将恶意负载直接部署到云托管文件服务器上。

items.reason_en: Sensitive data leakage in Azure HDInsight could expose proprietary datasets and credentials to external threat actors.
items.reason_zh: Azure HDInsight中的敏感数据泄露可能向外部威胁行为者暴露专有数据集和凭据。

items.reason_en: Improper access control in Hyper-V allows guest virtual machines to escape isolation and execute code on the host, breaking cloud tenant boundaries.
items.reason_zh: Hyper-V中的访问控制不当允许客户虚拟机逃逸隔离并在主机上执行代码，破坏云租户边界。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in Hyper-V enables local privilege escalation within the virtualization layer, threatening multi-tenant infrastructure stability.
items.reason_zh: Hyper-V中的堆溢出漏洞可在虚拟化层内实现本地权限提升，威胁多租户基础设施的稳定性。

items.reason_en: Missing authentication in Azure Kubernetes Configuration Service allows unauthenticated privilege escalation, compromising container orchestration infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Azure Kubernetes Configuration Service中缺失的身份验证可导致未授权权限提升，破坏容器编排基础设施。

items.reason_en: Improper authentication in AAD App Proxy enables unauthorized access to protected internal resources by bypassing identity verification.
items.reason_zh: AAD App Proxy中的身份验证不当可通过绕过身份验证机制，实现对受保护内部资源的未授权访问。

items.reason_en: Command injection in Azure Pipelines allows remote code execution via crafted pipeline configurations, threatening CI/CD supply chains.
items.reason_zh: Azure Pipelines中的命令注入漏洞允许通过构造的流水线配置实现远程代码执行，威胁CI/CD供应链。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated anonymous callers can poison shared Redis caches across tenants, collapsing multi-tenant isolation and credential encryption boundaries.
items.reason_zh: 未经身份验证的匿名调用者可污染跨租户共享的Redis缓存，导致多租户隔离和凭据加密边界失效。

items.reason_en: Low-privileged remote attackers can elevate privileges by exploiting improper checks for dropped privileges in enterprise data protection appliances.
items.reason_zh: 低权限远程攻击者可通过利用企业数据保护设备中对权限降级检查的不当处理来实现权限提升。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in monitoring dashboards leaks cloud provider access tokens, enabling unauthorized access to external infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: 监控仪表板中的服务器端请求伪造漏洞会泄露云提供商访问令牌，使攻击者能够未授权访问外部基础设施。

items.reason_en: Argo CD's insecure jsonnet import evaluation allows unrestricted file access outside repository roots, enabling arbitrary code execution during GitOps deployments.
items.reason_zh: Argo CD中不安全的jsonnet导入评估机制允许不受限制地访问仓库根目录之外的文件，从而在GitOps部署期间实现任意代码执行。

items.reason_en: Shell command injection in Eclipse Che constructs unsafe commands from user input, allowing attackers to execute arbitrary code with service privileges.
items.reason_zh: Eclipse Che中的Shell命令注入漏洞将用户输入拼接为不安全命令，允许攻击者以服务权限执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Dell PowerProtect Data Domain firmware enables unauthenticated remote attackers to achieve code execution.
items.reason_zh: Dell PowerProtect Data Domain固件中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未经身份验证的远程攻击者实现代码执行。

items.reason_en: Code injection in EagleCloud Aquila's Pigeon MFA service allows authenticated attackers to bypass identity protections and execute arbitrary code.
items.reason_zh: EagleCloud Aquila的Pigeon MFA服务中的代码注入漏洞允许已认证攻击者绕过身份保护并执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in the Kubernetes Ingress-NGINX provider allows unauthenticated users to route traffic through sensitive backend services.
items.reason_zh: Kubernetes Ingress-NGINX提供程序中的身份验证绕过漏洞允许未认证用户将流量路由至敏感的后端服务。

items.reason_en: Access-control annotations are incorrectly ignored for non-TLS entry points, exposing protected APIs to unauthenticated internet traffic.
items.reason_zh: 非TLS入口点的访问控制注解被错误忽略，导致受保护的API暴露于未经身份验证的互联网流量中。

items.reason_en: Denial of service vulnerability in Cisco ASA/FTD SSL VPN service allows unauthenticated remote attackers to crash critical firewall appliances.
items.reason_zh: Cisco ASA/FTD SSL VPN服务中的拒绝服务漏洞允许未经身份验证的远程攻击者导致关键防火墙设备崩溃。

items.reason_en: Origin validation error in Windows NAT enables adjacent network spoofing attacks that can bypass perimeter security controls.
items.reason_zh: Windows NAT中的来源验证错误可启用相邻网络欺骗攻击，从而绕过边界安全控制。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.3 Origin validation error in Windows NAT allows adjacent network spoofing, compromising internal routing and segmentation.

items.reason_en: CVSS 7 Use-after-free in WinSock is actively exploited in the wild (CISA KEV), allowing local privilege escalation on networked endpoints.
items.reason_zh: WinSock中CVSS评分为7的释放后使用漏洞已在野外被积极利用（列入CISA KEV），允许在网络化终端上实现本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: CVSS 7.5 Race condition in Windows SMB allows authenticated attackers to elevate privileges over the network.
items.reason_zh: Windows SMB中CVSS评分为7.5的竞争条件漏洞允许已认证攻击者通过网络提升权限。

items.reason_en: Uninitialized resource usage in Windows RDP enables critical remote code execution, allowing unauthorized network attackers to fully compromise target machines.
items.reason_zh: Windows RDP中的未初始化资源使用漏洞可导致严重的远程代码执行，使未经授权的网络攻击者能够完全控制目标机器。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in Microsoft QUIC compromises the modern transport protocol implementation, enabling remote attackers to execute code over the network.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft QUIC中的释放后使用漏洞破坏了现代传输协议实现，使远程攻击者能够通过网络执行代码。

items.reason_en: Race condition in the Windows Server network driver allows unauthorized remote code execution, destabilizing core server infrastructure and network operations.
items.reason_zh: Windows Server 网络驱动程序中的竞争条件可导致未授权的远程代码执行，破坏核心服务器基础设施和网络运行。

items.reason_en: OS command injection vulnerability in Totolink X2000R enables arbitrary system command execution, granting attackers full control over affected routing hardware.
items.reason_zh: Totolink X2000R 中的操作系统命令注入漏洞可执行任意系统命令，使攻击者完全控制受影响的无线路由硬件。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in Windows DHCP Server enables local privilege escalation and adjacent network code execution, disrupting critical IP address management infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server 中的堆溢出漏洞可导致本地权限提升及相邻网络代码执行，破坏关键的 IP 地址管理基础设施。

items.reason_en: Resource exhaustion in HTTP.sys enables denial-of-service attacks against network-facing Windows servers, disrupting critical network services.

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in DHCP Server allows network-based code execution, threatening critical network address management and infrastructure availability.

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in SSTP allows remote code execution over network tunnels, compromising secure VPN and remote access connections.
items.reason_zh: SSTP 中的释放后使用漏洞允许通过网络隧道进行远程代码执行，破坏安全的 VPN 和远程访问连接。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows FTP Service allows unauthenticated remote code execution over a network, compromising file transfer infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Windows FTP Service 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未经认证的远程代码执行，破坏文件传输基础设施。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free flaw in the DNS Server component enables remote code execution over a network without authentication, threatening name resolution reliability.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 组件中的释放后使用漏洞可在无需认证的情况下通过网络实现远程代码执行，威胁名称解析的可靠性。

items.reason_en: Race condition in the Windows TCP/IP stack permits adjacent network attackers to execute code by exploiting improper synchronization during packet handling.
items.reason_zh: Windows TCP/IP 协议栈中的竞争条件允许相邻网络攻击者通过在数据包处理期间利用不当同步来执行代码。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Bluetooth port driver allows adjacent network exploitation leading to remote code execution via wireless protocols.
items.reason_zh: Bluetooth 端口驱动程序中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许相邻网络利用，导致通过无线协议进行远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in DNS Server permits unauthenticated remote code execution via crafted queries, destabilizing critical network name resolution infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: DNS Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许通过构造的查询进行未经认证的远程代码执行，破坏关键的网络名称解析基础设施。

items.reason_en: Path traversal vulnerability in Sophos UTM email proxy scanning triggers a race condition leading to root-level remote code execution on end-of-life appliances.
items.reason_zh: Sophos UTM 电子邮件代理扫描中的路径遍历漏洞会触发竞争条件，导致在生命周期结束设备上发生根级别远程代码执行。

items.reason_zh: Samba 的 Ceph RGW 模块中的访问控制绕过漏洞允许经过认证的用户因路径解析缺陷读取或覆盖网络共享上的受限文件。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in Traefik's FastProxy connection pool mismanages NTLM sessions, enabling unauthenticated clients to hijack backend connections.
items.reason_zh: Traefik 的 FastProxy 连接池中的身份验证绕过漏洞错误管理 NTLM 会话，使未经认证的客户端能够劫持后端连接。

items.reason_zh: Network Policy Server (NPS) 中 CVSS 评分为 9.8 的基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞可启用未经授权的远程代码执行。NPS 对 802.1X 身份验证和网络访问控制至关重要。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 type confusion in the RPC Runtime allows unauthorized remote code execution across networked systems. Compromising RPC undermines fundamental inter-process and service communication security.
items.reason_zh: RPC Runtime 中 CVSS 评分为 8.8 的类型混淆漏洞允许跨联网系统的未经授权远程代码执行。破坏 RPC 将削弱基本的进程间和服务通信安全性。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in the Windows DHCP Server allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code over the network, disrupting core IP address management infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server 中的释放后使用漏洞允许未经认证的攻击者通过网络执行任意代码，破坏核心 IP 地址管理基础设施。

items.reason_zh: Network Device Enrollment Service 中的弱身份验证漏洞允许未经授权的代码执行，破坏安全的设备配置和证书管理工作流。

items.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in the Windows DNS Server allows remote code execution over the network. DNS is foundational network infrastructure, making this a high-impact target for lateral movement.
items.reason_zh: Windows DNS Server 中的不受信任指针解引用漏洞允许通过网络进行远程代码执行。DNS 是基础网络基础设施，使其成为横向移动的高影响目标。

items.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server 中的双重释放漏洞允许通过网络进行远程代码执行。利用该漏洞可破坏网络地址分配并促进全面接管网络。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in DHCP Server enables remote code execution over the network, threatening core network infrastructure stability.

items.reason_zh: DNS Server 中的类型混淆漏洞允许已授权攻击者通过网络执行代码，危及关键名称解析基础设施，并可导致 DNS 缓存投毒或服务中断。

items.reason_zh: Network Policy Server 中存在的关键整数处理缺陷允许远程攻击者执行任意代码，危及网络认证基础设施。

items.reason_zh: RRAS 中存在的未认证远程代码执行漏洞直接威胁网络边界安全，使攻击者能够劫持路由流量并获取系统完整控制权。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows Error Reporting allows unauthenticated remote code execution, making it a critical threat to networked endpoints.

items.reason_en: Missing resource allocation limits in the SMB Server enables unauthenticated remote denial-of-service, disrupting file sharing and inter-server communications.
items.reason_zh: SMB Server 中缺失的资源分配限制可导致未经认证的远程拒绝服务（DoS）攻击，破坏文件共享与服务器间通信。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in DNS Server allows remote code execution over the network, directly threatening foundational name resolution infrastructure.

items.reason_zh: 该漏洞正遭野外活跃利用，因未能正确处理受信任的配置数据，导致攻击者可在关键网络安全设备上将权限提升至 root 级别。

items.reason_en: Critical authentication engine flaw in Oracle Access Manager allows unauthenticated network attackers to fully compromise identity infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Oracle Access Manager 中关键的身份验证引擎缺陷允许未经认证的网络攻击者彻底破坏身份基础设施。

items.reason_en: Admin privilege abuse in Wing FTP Server allows directory escape and arbitrary file writes, leading to remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: Wing FTP Server 中的管理员权限滥用漏洞可导致目录逃逸与任意文件写入，进而引发远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Unbounded RPC statistics tracking in rpcbind causes memory exhaustion, enabling reliable denial of service on network services.
items.reason_zh: rpcbind 中无限制的 RPC 统计跟踪会导致内存耗尽，从而实现对网络服务的稳定拒绝服务（DoS）攻击。

items.reason_en: Remote stack-based buffer overflow in router firmware grants attackers immediate remote code execution with critical network control implications.
items.reason_zh: 路由器固件中存在的远程基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞可使攻击者立即执行远程代码，对网络控制权造成重大影响。

items.reason_en: Session token replay vulnerability allows attackers to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to router management interfaces without credentials.
items.reason_zh: 会话令牌重放漏洞允许攻击者绕过身份验证机制，在无有效凭据的情况下非法访问路由器管理界面。

items.reason_en: OS command injection via timer parameters allows authenticated users to execute arbitrary system commands on legacy gateway devices.
items.reason_zh: 通过定时器参数触发的操作系统命令注入漏洞，允许已认证用户在老旧网关设备上执行任意系统命令。

items.reason_en: Local privilege escalation in the CGM CLININET HL7 processing service runs with root privileges, allowing attackers to modify critical system configurations.
items.reason_zh: CGM CLININET HL7 处理服务中存在的本地权限提升漏洞以 root 权限运行，使攻击者能够修改关键系统配置。

items.reason_en: Missing forward-port of a critical VoIP protocol parser fix leaves telephony endpoints vulnerable to known exploitation techniques.
items.reason_zh: 关键 VoIP 协议解析器修复补丁未被正确移植，导致电话终端易受已知利用技术的攻击。

items.reason_en: Read-only API users can execute diagnostic write commands, potentially disrupting industrial communication systems or escalating privileges.
items.reason_zh: 只读API用户可执行诊断写入命令，可能破坏工业通信系统或提升权限。

items.reason_en: Critical session hijacking flaw in AVideo live-streaming endpoint allows unauthenticated attackers to take over user sessions via malicious streamer names.
items.reason_zh: AVideo直播流端点存在关键会话劫持漏洞，允许未认证攻击者通过恶意主播名称接管用户会话。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables network-based spoofing and credential theft against enterprise users.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint中的跨站脚本漏洞可导致针对企业用户的网络欺骗与凭据窃取。

items.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in SharePoint allows authorized attackers to execute arbitrary code over the network.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint中不受信任数据的反序列化漏洞允许已认证攻击者在网络上执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: SharePoint is frequently internet-facing; unsafe deserialization here provides a direct path to server-side code execution by authenticated attackers.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint通常面向互联网；此处的不安全反序列化会为已认证攻击者提供直接实现服务器端代码执行的途径。

items.reason_en: Unprotected administrative endpoints in SharePoint can be abused to escalate privileges and exfiltrate sensitive organizational data across the network.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint中未受保护的管理端点可能被滥用以提升权限，并在网络范围内外泄敏感的组织数据。

items.reason_en: Replay attacks against Exchange Server authentication mechanisms undermine email security and facilitate unauthorized mailbox access and privilege escalation.
items.reason_zh: 针对Exchange Server认证机制的重放攻击会削弱邮件安全性，并促成未经授权的邮箱访问与权限提升。

items.reason_en: SSRF vulnerabilities enable internal network pivoting and metadata access, which can be chained to achieve full system compromise in web-facing applications.
items.reason_zh: SSRF漏洞可实现内网横向移动与元数据访问，在面向Web的应用中可被串联以实现系统完全沦陷。

items.reason_en: CVSS 9 Type confusion in Edge allows unauthenticated remote code execution via malicious websites, representing a critical browser vulnerability.
items.reason_zh: CVSS评分为9的Edge类型混淆漏洞允许未认证攻击者通过恶意网站实现远程代码执行，属于严重的浏览器漏洞。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 Server-side request forgery in SharePoint enables authenticated attackers to pivot internally and access restricted backend resources.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint中存在CVSS 8.8分的服务器端请求伪造漏洞，允许已认证攻击者在内网进行横向移动并访问受限的后端资源。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 Deserialization of untrusted data in SharePoint allows authenticated remote code execution via crafted documents.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint中存在CVSS 8.8分的不可信数据反序列化漏洞，允许已认证攻击者通过构造文档实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 OS command injection in Visual Studio Code allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code over the network.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code中存在CVSS 8.8分的操作系统命令注入漏洞，允许未认证攻击者通过网络执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Injection vulnerability in GitHub Copilot and Visual Studio allows bypassing security features, potentially exposing developers to malicious code generation or environment manipulation.
items.reason_zh: GitHub Copilot和Visual Studio中的注入漏洞可绕过安全特性，可能导致开发人员面临恶意代码生成或环境篡改的风险。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Microsoft Edge enables spoofing attacks that can leak internal network resources or credentials through crafted browser interactions.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Edge中的服务器端请求伪造漏洞可启用欺骗攻击，通过构造的浏览器交互行为泄露内网资源或凭据。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Exchange Server allows authenticated attackers to perform spoofing attacks within the web interface, undermining user trust and session security.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Server中的跨站脚本漏洞允许已认证攻击者在Web界面中实施欺骗攻击，损害用户信任与会话安全性。

items.reason_en: Listed in CISA KEV with CVSS 9.1, weak authentication in SharePoint allows network-based security feature bypass, indicating confirmed active exploitation in the wild.
items.reason_zh: 该漏洞已列入CISA KEV目录（CVSS 9.1），SharePoint中的弱认证机制可导致基于网络的安防功能绕过，表明现实中已确认存在活跃利用。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting flaw in SharePoint enables network-based spoofing attacks, potentially compromising user credentials and session integrity across web portals.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint中的跨站脚本漏洞可支持网络欺骗攻击，可能危及Web门户中用户的凭据与会话完整性。

items.reason_en: Format string and template injection in the Tianji monitoring platform allows remote code execution, endangering self-hosted analytics and uptime dashboard deployments.
items.reason_zh: Tianji监控平台中的格式化字符串与模板注入漏洞可导致远程代码执行，威胁自托管分析系统与运行状态仪表板部署的安全。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Office SharePoint enables session hijacking and phishing attacks against collaborative workspace users relying on web interfaces.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint中的跨站脚本漏洞可对依赖Web界面的协作空间用户实施会话劫持与钓鱼攻击。

items.reason_en: Known exploited deserialization flaw in SharePoint allows unauthenticated remote code execution over the network, actively targeted by threat actors.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint中已知遭利用的反序列化漏洞允许未认证攻击者通过网络执行远程代码，目前正受到威胁行为体的主动攻击。

items.reason_en: Another critically exploited SharePoint deserialization vulnerability enabling network RCE, highlighting severe risks in widely deployed collaboration platforms.
items.reason_zh: 另一处遭严重利用的SharePoint反序列化漏洞可触发网络远程代码执行(RCE)，凸显了广泛部署的协作平台面临的严峻风险。

items.reason_en: Reflected cross-site scripting in Zimbra Classic Web Client allows JavaScript injection via manipulated document editor parameters, facilitating account takeover.
items.reason_zh: Zimbra Classic Web Client中的反射型跨站脚本漏洞允许通过篡改文档编辑器参数注入JavaScript，从而促成账户接管。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Power BI enables authorized attackers to perform spoofing attacks over the network, compromising data visualization integrity.
items.reason_zh: Power BI中的跨站脚本漏洞允许已认证攻击者实施网络欺骗攻击，破坏数据可视化的完整性。

items.reason_en: Command injection in Copilot Chat allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code over a network by exploiting insufficient input validation.
items.reason_zh: Copilot Chat中的命令注入漏洞可通过利用输入验证不足，允许未认证攻击者通过网络执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Exchange Server enables account spoofing and network-wide attacks targeting email clients and web interfaces.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server中的跨站脚本漏洞可支持账户欺骗及针对邮件客户端和Web界面的全网范围攻击。

items.reason_en: Authentication bypass in ASP.NET Core via assumed-immutable data allows attackers to elevate privileges over a network without valid credentials.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core中基于假定不可变数据的认证绕过漏洞，允许攻击者在无有效凭据的情况下通过网络提升权限。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in Zimbra allows delegated administrators to overwrite global configurations and inject malicious proxy domains, compromising collaboration platforms.
items.reason_zh: Zimbra中缺失的授权检查允许委派管理员覆盖全局配置并注入恶意代理域名，从而危及协作平台。

items.reason_en: Debug scripts in FearlessCMS lack authentication and CSRF protection, allowing unauthenticated attackers to perform privileged administrative actions directly.
items.reason_zh: FearlessCMS中的调试脚本缺乏身份认证与CSRF防护，允许未认证攻击者直接执行高权限管理操作。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in Decap CMS local proxy guard bypasses repository containment, enabling attackers to read, modify, or delete files outside the intended scope.
items.reason_zh: Decap CMS本地代理守卫中的路径遍历漏洞可突破仓库隔离限制，使攻击者能够读取、修改或删除预期范围之外的文件。

items.reason_en: TokenGuard authentication bypass in Laravel permits unintended user login under specific MySQL/MariaDB configurations due to weak credential type validation.
items.reason_zh: Laravel中TokenGuard的认证绕过漏洞因凭据类型验证薄弱，在特定MySQL/MariaDB配置下可导致非预期用户登录。

items.reason_en: Remote code execution in MONAI occurs when malicious bundle logging configurations are evaluated, threatening AI/ML pipeline integrity and host systems.
items.reason_zh: MONAI 中的远程代码执行漏洞在评估恶意捆绑包日志配置时触发，威胁 AI/ML 流水线完整性及主机系统。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 code injection flaw in ASP.NET Core permits unauthorized remote code execution over the network. It directly impacts backend web application frameworks and API services.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中 CVSS 评分为 8.8 的代码注入缺陷允许未经授权的远程网络代码执行。该漏洞直接影响后端 Web 应用框架和 API 服务。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.8 improper path equivalence resolution in WebDAV allows network privilege escalation. This weakens secure file synchronization and enterprise webdav deployments.
items.reason_zh: WebDAV 中 CVSS 评分为 8.8 的路径等价解析不当漏洞可导致网络权限提升。此漏洞削弱了安全文件同步功能及企业级 WebDAV 部署的安全性。

items.reason_en: HTTP request/response smuggling in ASP.NET Core allows attackers to bypass security controls and tamper with web traffic, complicating WAF and proxy defenses.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中的 HTTP 请求/响应走私漏洞使攻击者能够绕过安全控制并篡改 Web 流量，增加了 WAF 和代理防御的复杂性。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Exchange Server enables unauthenticated spoofing attacks, compromising webmail interfaces, user credentials, and corporate communications.
items.reason_zh: Exchange Server 中的跨站脚本漏洞可启用未认证的欺骗攻击，危及 Webmail 界面、用户凭据及企业通信。

items.reason_en: Unsafe deserialization in .NET allows unauthenticated attackers to execute code over the network, widely affecting modern web applications, APIs, and microservices.
items.reason_zh: .NET 中的不安全反序列化漏洞允许未认证攻击者在网络上执行代码，广泛影响现代 Web 应用、API 及微服务。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft XML parsing enables remote code execution over the network. Malicious XML payloads are a common initial access vector for web-based attacks.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft XML 解析中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞可实现远程网络代码执行。恶意 XML 载荷是 Web 攻击常见的初始访问向量。

items.reason_en: Improper privilege management in wininet.dll allows local spoofing attacks. This undermines browser trust models and facilitates phishing or man-in-the-middle scenarios.
items.reason_zh: wininet.dll 中的权限管理不当漏洞可导致本地欺骗攻击。该漏洞破坏了浏览器信任模型，并为钓鱼或中间人攻击创造条件。

items.reason_en: Highcharts JS fails to validate URL schemes in grid configurations, enabling cross-site scripting when attackers control chart rendering parameters.
items.reason_zh: Highcharts JS 未在网格配置中验证 URL 协议，当攻击者控制图表渲染参数时可引发跨站脚本漏洞。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in SharePoint allows unauthorized spoofing over the network, facilitating targeted phishing and session hijacking.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的跨站脚本漏洞允许网络未授权欺骗，助长定向钓鱼与会话劫持。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in SharePoint enables privilege escalation over the network, allowing unauthenticated users to access sensitive web content.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中缺失授权检查可导致网络权限提升，使未认证用户能够访问敏感 Web 内容。

items.reason_en: Resource exhaustion in ASP.NET Core permits denial-of-service attacks over the network, disrupting web application availability.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中的资源耗尽漏洞可导致网络拒绝服务攻击，破坏 Web 应用的可用性。

items.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Internet Information Services (IIS) allows unauthenticated remote code execution over the network, directly exposing web servers to immediate compromise and service disruption.
items.reason_zh: Internet Information Services (IIS) 中的栈缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未认证的远程网络代码执行，直接导致 Web 服务器面临即时被攻陷及服务中断风险。

items.reason_en: HTTP request/response smuggling in ASP.NET Core enables unauthorized attackers to bypass security controls, potentially leading to cache poisoning, session hijacking, or backend resource abuse.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中的 HTTP 请求/响应走私漏洞使未授权攻击者能够绕过安全控制，可能导致缓存投毒、会话劫持或后端资源滥用。

items.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in WebDAV allows unauthenticated network attackers to elevate privileges, exploiting a widely used file synchronization protocol to gain unauthorized system access.
items.reason_zh: WebDAV 中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞允许未认证的网络攻击者提升权限，通过利用广泛使用的文件同步协议获取未授权的系统访问权。

items.reason_en: Weak authentication in Active Directory Federation Services permits network-based spoofing attacks, undermining single sign-on architectures and enabling unauthorized access to federated applications.
items.reason_zh: Active Directory Federation Services 中的弱认证机制允许基于网络的欺骗攻击，破坏单点登录架构并导致对联合应用的未授权访问。

items.reason_en: Origin validation error in Microsoft Power Apps allows authorized attackers to execute cross-origin scripts, risking data exfiltration and unauthorized manipulation of business logic workflows.
items.reason_zh: Microsoft Power Apps 中的来源验证错误允许已认证攻击者执行跨域脚本，存在数据外泄及未授权操纵业务逻辑工作流的风险。

items.reason_en: Cross-site scripting vulnerability in a popular JavaScript charting library allows attackers to inject malicious scripts into web applications rendering dynamic data.
items.reason_zh: 某流行 JavaScript 图表库中的跨站脚本漏洞使攻击者能够将恶意脚本注入渲染动态数据的 Web 应用中。

items.reason_en: Memory corruption in WebDAV protocol handlers can be leveraged by authenticated users to crash services or escalate privileges within web-facing environments.
items.reason_zh: WebDAV 协议处理程序中的内存损坏漏洞可被已认证用户利用，以崩溃面向 Web 的环境中的服务或提升权限。

items.reason_en: Highcharts Dashboards incorrectly parses language labels as HTML, enabling stored cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks when attackers control dashboard configurations.
items.reason_zh: Highcharts Dashboards 将语言标签错误解析为 HTML，当攻击者控制仪表板配置时可触发存储型跨站脚本（XSS）攻击。

items.reason_en: Django REST framework accepts unbounded Accept tokens, leading to algorithmic complexity denial-of-service attacks against web APIs and backend services.
items.reason_zh: Django REST framework 接受无界 Accept 令牌，导致针对 Web API 和后端服务的算法复杂度拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Type confusion in Chromium-based Microsoft Edge allows remote code execution via malicious web content, posing a significant risk to modern browsing sessions.
items.reason_zh: 基于 Chromium 的 Microsoft Edge 中的类型混淆漏洞可通过恶意 Web 内容实现远程代码执行，对现代浏览会话构成重大风险。

items.reason_en: Path traversal in SharePoint enables remote code execution on enterprise web servers, potentially leading to full server compromise.
items.reason_zh: SharePoint 中的路径遍历漏洞可在企业 Web 服务器上实现远程代码执行，可能导致服务器完全沦陷。

items.reason_en: Resource exhaustion in ASP.NET Core allows denial of service against web applications, disrupting availability for downstream users.
items.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core 中的资源耗尽漏洞可对 Web 应用发起拒绝服务攻击，中断下游用户的可用服务。

items.reason_en: Command injection in Visual Studio Code permits remote code execution through crafted workspace configurations, affecting developer workflows.
items.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code 中的命令注入漏洞可通过构造的工作区配置实现远程代码执行，影响开发者工作流程。

items.reason_en: Blind SQL injection in the SendPress WordPress plugin exposes sensitive database contents without requiring authentication.
items.reason_zh: SendPress WordPress 插件中的盲 SQL 注入漏洞可在无需认证的情况下暴露敏感数据库内容。

items.reason_en: Malicious chart configurations in Highcharts execute arbitrary JavaScript in dashboards, compromising data visualization platforms via XSS.
items.reason_zh: Highcharts 中的恶意图表配置可在仪表板中执行任意 JavaScript，通过 XSS 漏洞破坏数据可视化平台。

items.reason_en: Insufficient MIME validation in the FV Player WordPress plugin enables remote attackers to upload and execute malicious scripts.
items.reason_zh: FV Player WordPress 插件中 MIME 验证不足，使远程攻击者能够上传并执行恶意脚本。

items.reason_en: Hardcoded JWT secrets enable unauthenticated attackers to forge administrator tokens, fully bypassing authentication mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: 硬编码的 JWT 密钥使未认证攻击者能够伪造管理员令牌，从而完全绕过认证机制。

items.reason_en: Macro rights elevation allows execution of restricted wiki content, bypassing intended access controls and enabling stored XSS.
items.reason_zh: 宏权限提升漏洞允许执行受限的 Wiki 内容，绕过预期的访问控制并触发存储型 XSS。

items.reason_en: Stored XSS in webmail components allows attackers to hijack authenticated user sessions via sanitized email attachment bypasses.
items.reason_zh: Webmail组件中的存储型XSS漏洞使攻击者可通过绕过邮件附件过滤机制，劫持已认证用户的会话。

items.reason_en: Sanitization bypass in rich text editors permits stored cross-site scripting during media processing, affecting numerous web applications.
items.reason_zh: 富文本编辑器中的过滤绕过漏洞可在媒体处理过程中引发存储型跨站脚本攻击，影响众多Web应用程序。

items.reason_en: Severe SQL injection in Adobe Campaign Classic enables low-privileged attackers to execute arbitrary code, compromising marketing automation systems.
items.reason_zh: Adobe Campaign Classic中存在严重SQL注入漏洞，使低权限攻击者可执行任意代码，危及营销自动化系统。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited unrestricted file upload in Adobe Commerce allows arbitrary code execution, directly threatening e-commerce platform integrity.
items.reason_zh: Adobe Commerce中存在未受限制的文件上传漏洞且正遭活跃利用，可导致任意代码执行，直接威胁电商平台完整性。

items.reason_en: Incomplete extension blacklist in Contact Manager WordPress plugin permits arbitrary file uploads, posing severe remote code execution risks.
items.reason_zh: Contact Manager WordPress插件中扩展黑名单不完整，允许任意文件上传，带来严重的远程代码执行风险。

items.reason_en: Insufficient file type validation in IvyForms plugin allows dangerous file uploads, enabling attackers to deploy malicious scripts on WordPress sites.
items.reason_zh: IvyForms插件中文件类型验证不充分，允许上传危险文件，使攻击者能在WordPress站点部署恶意脚本。

items.reason_en: Allows unauthenticated attackers to upload arbitrary files due to inadequate type validation, directly enabling full web server compromise via malicious script execution.
items.reason_zh: 因类型验证不足，允许未授权攻击者上传任意文件，直接通过执行恶意脚本导致Web服务器被完全控制。

items.reason_en: Exploits flawed OAuth callback verification to bypass authentication mechanisms, granting unauthorized administrative access to WordPress sites.
items.reason_zh: 利用存在缺陷的OAuth回调验证机制绕过身份认证，为WordPress站点获取未授权的管理员访问权限。

items.reason_en: Server-side request forgery filter bypass enables attackers to probe internal networks and access restricted services from the compromised mail server.
items.reason_zh: 服务端请求伪造过滤器绕过漏洞使攻击者能够从已被攻陷的邮件服务器探测内网并访问受限服务。

items.reason_en: Enables authenticated administrators to execute arbitrary PHP code by importing a crafted language pack, posing a significant risk to educational platforms.
items.reason_zh: 允许已认证管理员通过导入特制语言包执行任意PHP代码，对教育类平台构成重大安全风险。

items.reason_zh: Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL)中的ToCTOU竞态条件可导致本地权限提升。影响依赖Windows主机运行跨平台Linux工具的开发者和企业。

items.reason_en: Race condition in Windows Autopilot allows local privilege escalation during device provisioning, potentially bypassing enrollment security controls.
items.reason_zh: Windows Autopilot中的竞态条件可在设备预配期间导致本地权限提升，可能绕过注册安全控制。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free in Windows Subsystem for Linux permits local privilege escalation, affecting developers and hybrid environment deployments.
items.reason_zh: Windows Subsystem for Linux中的释放后使用（UAF）漏洞可导致本地权限提升，影响开发者和混合环境部署。

items.reason_en: Memory disclosure vulnerability in the Hyper-V hypervisor layer risks guest-to-host escape attacks, potentially compromising virtualized infrastructure isolation.
items.reason_zh: Hyper-V 虚拟机监控程序层中的内存泄露漏洞可能导致客户机到主机逃逸攻击，进而破坏虚拟化基础设施的隔离性。

items.reason_en: Use-after-free flaw in telephony services creates instability and potential privilege escalation vectors for attackers targeting communication-related workloads.
items.reason_zh: 电话服务中的释放后使用漏洞会导致系统不稳定，并为针对通信相关负载的攻击者提供潜在的提权途径。

items.reason_en: Inefficient algorithmic complexity in .NET allows unauthenticated remote denial-of-service, impacting application runtime stability across multiple Windows server and client versions.
items.reason_zh: .NET 中低效的算法复杂度可导致未认证的远程拒绝服务攻击，影响多个 Windows 服务器和客户端版本的应用程序运行时稳定性。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in LSASS permits unauthenticated remote denial-of-service, threatening credential validation processes and overall system availability.
items.reason_zh: LSASS 中的越界读取漏洞允许未认证的远程拒绝服务攻击，威胁凭据验证流程及整体系统可用性。

items.reason_en: Heap overflow in Libarchive allows remote code execution via malicious compressed files, impacting numerous third-party applications that rely on the library.
items.reason_zh: Libarchive 中的堆溢出漏洞可通过恶意压缩文件实现远程代码执行，影响大量依赖该库的第三方应用程序。

items.reason_en: Improper resource release in Windows UEFI allows local bypass of security features during system boot, potentially compromising firmware-level protections.
items.reason_zh: Windows UEFI 中的资源释放不当漏洞可在系统启动期间本地绕过安全功能，可能破坏固件级防护机制。

items.reason_en: Quadratic time complexity in RE2JS regex matching enables denial-of-service attacks in client-side JavaScript applications.
items.reason_zh: RE2JS 正则表达式匹配中的二次时间复杂度可引发客户端 JavaScript 应用程序的拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Missing authorization in Grafana allows authenticated users to exfiltrate SSO client secrets, breaking identity federation security.
items.reason_zh: Grafana 中缺失的授权检查允许已认证用户窃取 SSO 客户端密钥，破坏身份联合安全性。

items.reason_en: Regex syntax error bypasses anonymous endpoint blocking, exposing terminal APIs to unauthenticated access in notebook sharing frameworks.
items.reason_zh: 正则表达式语法错误可绕过匿名端点拦截，导致笔记本共享框架中的终端 API 暴露于未认证访问之下。

items.reason_en: Insecure deserialization in presentation libraries allows arbitrary PHP object instantiation and remote code execution via uploaded files.
items.reason_zh: 演示库中的不安全反序列化漏洞允许通过上传文件实例化任意 PHP 对象并实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Non-administrator users can inject system-level UID/GID fields into scheduled tasks, potentially executing processes with elevated privileges.
items.reason_zh: 非管理员用户可将系统级 UID/GID 字段注入计划任务中，从而以高权限执行进程。

items.reason_en: O(n²) complexity in markdown parsing enables denial of service attacks against applications rendering user-generated content.
items.reason_zh: Markdown 解析中的 O(n²) 复杂度可针对渲染用户生成内容的应用程序实施拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Actively exploited buffer overflow in Google Brotli decoder allows memory corruption, data disclosure, or code execution across all platforms.
items.reason_zh: Google Brotli 解码器中被主动利用的缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致内存损坏、数据泄露或跨平台代码执行。

items.reason_en: Critical OS command injection in KaliFast Git remote configuration allows authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary commands with www-data privileges.
items.reason_zh: KaliFast Git 远程配置中存在严重的操作系统命令注入漏洞，允许已认证攻击者以 www-data 权限执行任意命令。

items.reason_en: Bundled librsvg dependency in sharp contains a memory corruption flaw that can lead to code execution when processing crafted SVG images.
items.reason_zh: sharp 捆绑的 librsvg 依赖库包含内存损坏漏洞，在处理构造的 SVG 图像时可能导致代码执行。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in the RDMA transport layer allows unauthenticated peers to crash or execute code on the host system running AI inference workloads.
items.reason_zh: RDMA 传输层中的越界写入漏洞允许未认证的对等节点使运行 AI 推理负载的主机系统崩溃或执行代码。

items.reason_en: Improper handling of duplicate indirect references in PDF parsing can lead to memory corruption or denial of service during image processing pipelines.
items.reason_zh: PDF 解析中对重复间接引用的处理不当可能导致图像处理流水线中出现内存损坏或拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: WebSocket handler fails to enforce proper authorization checks, allowing unauthorized kernel execution requests in Jupyter notebook environments.
items.reason_zh: WebSocket 处理器未能正确执行授权检查，导致在 Jupyter Notebook 环境中允许未经授权的内核执行请求。
